title: Found a photo of a location
content: I've only been here once, a new location as opposed to most of the others which are repetitive for most of my life. Literally everything is as I described it to my friend after the dream (I typically lucid dream & I write as much detail as possible- like furniture!) In my dream, it was a HUGE luxury house boat, but really just a regular house floating. the deck wrapped around the whole house except for one spot of stairs & some sort of solar air unit on the wall. anyways I saw this photo come up on pinterest & was in shock. I don't have anything similar pinned either which is weirder.
